newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Sowa Bank to revise 96/97 earnings forecast.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Sowa Bank to revise 96/97 earnings forecast.

text.p: Tokyo Sowa Bank Ltd said on Friday it would hold a news conference at 3.30 p.m. (0630 GMT) on an earnings forecast revision.
The Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said in its Friday edition that the Tokyo-based regional bank is expected to have made a net loss of 30 billion yen in 1996/97, ended in March.

The paper said the bank is expected to post loan losses of about 20 billion yen in 1996/97. The bank is also expected to have made an appraisal loss of about 30 billion yen on its securities holdings, it said.
